name: ChiRen Blade
author: Altair
description: After a successful clash with the ChiRen blade, the next heavy attacks cost no Shachi, the blade burns, and the player gets a short invulnerability. The ChiRen whirlwind (风回云卷) deals 3-6x damage based on the clash streak (up to six stored clashes) and starts or extends the fire; three clashes also interrupt the target with the game's native Break hit reaction. Independently, every heavy attack costs half the usual Shachi.
